tagline: Type editing commands in the search bar
summary: Lets you type what you want in the Ctrl+K search bar, like "trim the selected clip to 5 seconds", and Drift does it. Runs on this computer, so nothing leaves your project and no account is needed.
useCases: Run edits by typing them instead of hunting through menus
Work without sending your project online
howTo: Type what you want done to your project

requires.reason: Runs the model on this computer
